serialization.notes: All seven methods restore identical predictions and reserialize byte-identically. Inference payloads charge the shared plane, every task code/adapter, task IDs and tensor-record metadata. Resume payloads use torch.save and include per-task or shared optimizer moments and step counters.

metric_replay.notes: RESULTS_CORE duplicates the selected-LR003 development table. Unique training records replayed all MSE, retention, actual-byte, examples/updates and active-compute fields exactly. Wall-clock and throughput were excluded from exact replay.

notes: Protocol was frozen at 6a2e22c08c3e766359c986e4b7202b4651feee39 before development; LR 0.003 was selected using the preregistered all-method/all-condition mean MSE.
Both development worlds missed the registered <=0.90x rank-1 LoRA total-inference-byte gate (1,103B vs 1,196B), so fresh seeds remained sealed.
The generic P@C_t shared-plane control had nearly identical mean aligned MSE and smaller optimizer resume state than the Mirror coordinate.
Independent task updates required private parameters. The supplied plane was synthetic; no capacity or language-model claim.
